soru: The meeting was cancelled because the manager was ill.
secenekler: The manager cancelled the meeting so that he could see a doctor.
Although the manager was ill, the meeting took place.
Since the manager was ill, the meeting was called off.
The meeting was postponed until the manager recovered.
The manager became ill after the meeting was cancelled.
aciklama: 'because' = 'since', 'cancelled' = 'called off'. 'postponed' (ertelendi) anlamı değiştirir.

soru: Hardly anyone expected the small company to become one of the leading firms in the industry.
secenekler: Very few people thought the small company would become one of the leading firms in the industry.
The small company expected to become one of the leading firms in the industry.
Nobody was surprised when the small company became a leading firm.
Most people were sure that the small company would lead the industry.
The small company hardly tried to become a leading firm in the industry.
aciklama: 'Hardly anyone' = neredeyse hiç kimse = 'very few people'. Beklenti öznesi şirket değil insanlardır.

soru: No sooner had the scientists published their findings than other researchers challenged them.
secenekler: The scientists challenged other researchers before publishing their own findings.
As soon as the scientists published their findings, other researchers challenged them.
Other researchers challenged the findings long after the scientists had published them.
Other researchers did not challenge the findings until the scientists published them again.
The scientists published their findings only after other researchers had challenged them.
aciklama: 'No sooner ... than' = …er …mez = 'As soon as'. Zaman sırası korunmalıdır.

soru: The more carefully a study is designed, the less likely it is to produce misleading results.
secenekler: A study designed with less care is less likely to produce misleading results.
Carefully designed studies always produce misleading results.
Studies that produce misleading results are usually designed too carefully.
Misleading results are less likely when a study is designed with greater care.
The design of a study has little effect on whether its results are misleading.
aciklama: Tasarım özeni arttıkça yanıltıcı sonuç olasılığı azalır; doğru seçenek aynı ters orantıyı korur.

soru: The exam was so difficult that only a few students passed it.
secenekler: Only a few students found the exam difficult.
The exam was easy, so many students passed it.
Although the exam was difficult, most students passed it.
No students passed the exam because it was too long.
Because the exam was very difficult, very few students passed it.
aciklama: 'so ... that' neden-sonuç bildirir: sınav çok zordu, bu yüzden çok az öğrenci geçti.

soru: It is not necessary to book a table in advance at this restaurant.
secenekler: Tables at this restaurant can only be booked on the same day.
You must book a table at this restaurant well in advance.
You don't need to reserve a table at this restaurant beforehand.
It is impossible to book a table at this restaurant.
Booking a table in advance at this restaurant is strongly recommended.
aciklama: 'not necessary' = gerekli değil = 'don't need to'. Rezervasyonun imkânsız olduğu söylenmiyor.

soru: Despite having studied English for years, he still finds it hard to understand native speakers.
secenekler: He stopped studying English because he couldn't understand native speakers.
Although he has studied English for years, understanding native speakers is still difficult for him.
Since he has studied English for years, he easily understands native speakers.
Native speakers find it hard to understand him, even though he studied English.
He has only recently started studying English, so native speakers are hard to understand.
aciklama: 'Despite' = 'Although'; zorluk çeken kişi odur, anadili konuşanlar değil.

soru: The new policy will benefit small businesses more than large companies.
secenekler: Large companies designed the new policy for their own benefit.
Only large companies will be affected by the new policy.
The new policy will harm small businesses.
Large companies will gain less from the new policy than small businesses.
Small and large businesses will benefit equally from the new policy.
aciklama: Küçük işletmelerin daha çok yararlanması, büyük şirketlerin daha az yararlanması demektir.

soru: Had it not been for her coach's encouragement, she would have given up competitive swimming.
secenekler: She continued competitive swimming thanks to her coach's encouragement.
Her coach encouraged her to give up competitive swimming.
She gave up competitive swimming even though her coach encouraged her.
She encouraged her coach not to give up swimming.
She would have continued swimming if her coach had encouraged her.
aciklama: 'Had it not been for' (…olmasaydı) geçmişte gerçekleşmeyen bir durumu anlatır: antrenör teşvik ettiği için yüzmeyi bırakmadı.

soru: Scarcely had the researchers begun the experiment when the equipment failed.
secenekler: The researchers rarely began experiments without checking the equipment.
The researchers began the experiment long after the equipment had failed.
The equipment worked perfectly until the end of the experiment.
The experiment was completed before the equipment failed.
The equipment failed almost as soon as the researchers had begun the experiment.
aciklama: 'Scarcely ... when' = …er …mez; deney başlar başlamaz ekipman bozuldu.

soru: I don't have enough money to buy a new car.
secenekler: New cars are cheaper than old ones.
I bought a new car with my money.
I have a lot of money for a new car.
I don't want a new car.
I can't afford a new car.
aciklama: 'not enough money to buy' = can't afford.

soru: The shop opens at nine and closes at six.
secenekler: The shop opens at six.
The shop never closes.
The shop is open from nine to six.
The shop is closed between nine and six.
The shop is open for three hours.
aciklama: Dokuzda açılıp altıda kapanmak = dokuzdan altıya açık.

soru: She is too young to drive a car.
secenekler: She has been driving for years.
She isn't old enough to drive a car.
She drives very carefully.
She is younger than her car.
She is old enough to drive.
aciklama: 'too young to' = 'not old enough to'.

soru: It's not necessary to bring food to the party.
secenekler: You don't need to bring food to the party.
You must bring food to the party.
Everyone is bringing food to the party.
Food isn't allowed at the party.
There won't be any food at the party.
aciklama: 'not necessary' = 'don't need to'; yasak anlamı yoktur.

soru: My sister is older than me.
secenekler: My sister and I are the same age.
I am older than my sister.
My sister is the oldest in the family.
I am younger than my sister.
My sister is younger than me.
aciklama: Kız kardeş daha büyükse ben daha küçüğüm.

soru: We started living here five years ago.
secenekler: We will live here for five years.
We lived here five years ago.
We have been here since last year.
We have lived here for five years.
We left this place five years ago.
aciklama: Beş yıl önce başlayıp süren durum = 'have lived for five years'.

soru: Nobody in the class passed the exam.
secenekler: All the students in the class failed the exam.
The exam was not taken by the class.
Only one student failed the exam.
Most of the class passed the exam.
Everyone passed the exam.
aciklama: Kimse geçmediyse herkes kalmıştır.

soru: The film was so funny that we laughed a lot.
secenekler: The film was sad, so we cried.
We didn't laugh although the film was funny.
The film was boring, but we laughed.
We watched a funny film last week.
We laughed a lot because the film was very funny.
aciklama: 'so ... that' neden-sonuç: film çok komikti, bu yüzden çok güldük.

soru: She missed the meeting because she was stuck in traffic.
secenekler: She went to the meeting to talk about traffic.
She never goes to meetings.
She was absent from the meeting due to heavy traffic.
She attended the meeting although the traffic was heavy.
She was stuck in traffic after the meeting.
aciklama: Trafik yüzünden toplantıyı kaçırmak = trafik nedeniyle toplantıda bulunmamak (absent due to).

soru: Could you please open the window?
secenekler: The window is already open.
Would you mind opening the window?
Why did you open the window?
I opened the window.
Please don't open the window.
aciklama: Kibar rica: 'Could you ...?' = 'Would you mind + -ing?'.

soru: This is the first time I have visited Paris.
secenekler: Paris is my favourite city.
I have never visited Paris before.
I have visited Paris many times.
I visited Paris last year.
I will visit Paris for the first time next year.
aciklama: İlk kez ziyaret = daha önce hiç ziyaret etmemek.

soru: I prefer tea to coffee.
secenekler: I like coffee more than tea.
I only drink coffee in the morning.
I like tea more than coffee.
Tea and coffee are the same.
I don't drink tea or coffee.
aciklama: 'prefer A to B' = A'yı B'den çok sevmek.

soru: The museum is free for children under twelve.
secenekler: Children under twelve are not allowed in the museum.
The museum is only for children.
Adults don't pay to enter the museum.
Children under twelve don't have to pay to enter the museum.
Children must pay half price.
aciklama: Ücretsiz = ödeme yapmak zorunda değil.

soru: It rained, so the match was cancelled.
secenekler: The match was called off because of the rain.
The match took place in the rain.
The match was cancelled, but it didn't rain.
The rain started because of the match.
It rained after the match.
aciklama: Neden-sonuç aynı: yağmur yüzünden maç iptal edildi.

soru: She has never been late for work.
secenekler: She is often late for work.
She will be late tomorrow.
She was late for work yesterday.
She doesn't go to work.
She is always on time for work.
aciklama: Hiç geç kalmamak = hep zamanında olmak.

soru: Despite the bad weather, thousands of people attended the festival.
secenekler: Although the weather was bad, thousands of people came to the festival.
Thousands of people attended because the weather was good.
The festival was cancelled due to the weather.
The weather got worse after the festival.
Because of the bad weather, few people attended.
aciklama: 'Despite + isim' = 'Although + cümle'.

soru: The more you exercise, the fitter you become.
secenekler: The fitter you are, the less you need to exercise.
Only fit people can exercise.
Exercise has no effect on fitness.
Your fitness improves as you exercise more.
You become less fit if you exercise more.
aciklama: Egzersiz arttıkça zindelik artar; yön korunmalıdır.

soru: Hardly anyone came to the meeting.
secenekler: Nobody was invited to the meeting.
The meeting was very crowded.
Very few people attended the meeting.
The meeting was hard for everyone.
Almost everyone came to the meeting.
aciklama: 'Hardly anyone' = çok az kişi.

soru: I wish I hadn't eaten so much.
secenekler: I'm glad I ate so much.
I didn't eat anything.
I will eat less tomorrow.
I want to eat more.
I regret eating so much.
aciklama: Geçmişe dair 'wish' pişmanlık bildirir = regret.

soru: The report was written by a team of experts.
secenekler: The experts read the report.
A team of experts wrote the report.
The experts didn't agree with the report.
The report criticised the team.
The report was about a team of experts.
aciklama: Edilgen cümlenin etken karşılığı.

soru: She is said to be the best doctor in the city.
secenekler: Nobody thinks she is a good doctor.
People say that she is the best doctor in the city.
She says she is the best doctor in the city.
She wants to be the best doctor in the city.
She was the best doctor in the city in the past.
aciklama: 'is said to be' = insanlar …olduğunu söylüyor; söyleyen kendisi değil.

soru: The meeting will go ahead unless it snows heavily.
secenekler: The meeting will take place only if it snows.
The meeting was cancelled because of snow.
It will snow after the meeting.
The meeting will take place if it doesn't snow heavily.
The meeting will be cancelled whether it snows or not.
aciklama: 'unless' = 'if ... not': Yoğun kar yağmazsa toplantı yapılacak. 'go ahead' burada 'take place' ile aynı anlamdadır.

soru: It took me three hours to finish the report.
secenekler: I have been writing the report for three days.
The report will take three hours.
I spent three hours finishing the report.
I finished the report in less than an hour.
I finished the report three hours ago.
aciklama: 'It took me X to do' = 'I spent X doing'.

soru: Not only is the new phone cheaper, but it is also faster.
secenekler: The new phone is faster but more expensive.
Only the old phone is fast.
The new phone is neither cheap nor fast.
The new phone is cheaper but slower.
The new phone is both cheaper and faster.
aciklama: 'Not only ... but also' = both ... and.

soru: The train had left by the time we reached the station.
secenekler: When we got to the station, the train had already gone.
We reached the station before the train left.
The train left after we reached the station.
The train was waiting when we arrived.
We caught the train at the station.
aciklama: Biz varmadan tren gitmişti; zaman sırası korunmalıdır.

soru: You had better see a doctor about that pain.
secenekler: It would be wise for you to consult a doctor about that pain.
The doctor has seen your pain.
You mustn't see a doctor.
You saw a doctor about that pain.
It's too late to see a doctor.
aciklama: 'had better' güçlü tavsiye = 'it would be wise'.

soru: The medicine must be kept out of the reach of children.
secenekler: The medicine can be reached easily by children.
Children must take the medicine.
The medicine is made for children.
Children must not be able to get to the medicine.
Children should keep the medicine.
aciklama: 'out of the reach of children' = çocukların ulaşamayacağı yerde.

soru: No other city in the country is as crowded as Istanbul.
secenekler: Istanbul is not crowded at all.
Istanbul is the most crowded city in the country.
Many cities are more crowded than Istanbul.
All cities in the country are equally crowded.
Istanbul is less crowded than other cities.
aciklama: 'No other ... as ... as X' = X en …dir.

soru: The concert was postponed until next month.
secenekler: The concert took place last month.
The concert was cancelled completely.
The concert will take place next month instead.
The concert lasted a month.
The concert will be held earlier than planned.
aciklama: Ertelenen konser gelecek ay yapılacaktır; iptal edilmemiştir.

soru: There is no point in arguing with him.
secenekler: He never argues with anyone.
It's important to argue with him.
You should argue with him about everything.
He has a good point.
It's useless to argue with him.
aciklama: 'no point in + -ing' = faydasız.

soru: Had the rescue team arrived earlier, more people would have survived.
secenekler: The rescue team arrived early, so everyone survived.
The number of survivors did not depend on the team.
Because the rescue team arrived late, fewer people survived.
The rescue team did not come at all.
More people survived because the team came early.
aciklama: Gerçekleşmemiş koşul: ekip geç geldi, bu yüzden daha az kişi kurtuldu.

soru: Scarcely had the plane taken off when it had to return because of a technical problem.
secenekler: The plane landed safely at its destination.
A technical problem was found before take-off.
The plane never took off because of a problem.
The plane returned long after taking off.
The plane had to return shortly after taking off due to a technical problem.
aciklama: 'Scarcely ... when' = …er …mez; kalkıştan hemen sonra dönmek.

soru: The findings are by no means conclusive.
secenekler: The findings are the final ones.
The findings are completely certain.
The findings were conclusive in the past.
The findings are far from certain.
There are no findings.
aciklama: 'by no means conclusive' = hiç de kesin değil = far from certain.

soru: It was not until he lost his job that he realised the value of saving money.
secenekler: He only understood the importance of saving after losing his job.
He lost his job because he didn't save money.
He realised the value of his job after saving money.
He saved a lot of money before losing his job.
He never realised the value of saving money.
aciklama: 'It was not until X that ...' = ancak X'ten sonra.

soru: Much as I admire his work, I cannot agree with his conclusions.
secenekler: Because I admire his work, I agree with him.
Although I admire his work, I disagree with his conclusions.
I agree with his conclusions but not his work.
I neither admire his work nor agree with him.
I admire his conclusions more than his work.
aciklama: 'Much as' = although (-e rağmen): Çalışmalarına hayran olsam da vardığı sonuçlara katılamıyorum.

soru: The new policy is unlikely to have any significant effect on unemployment.
secenekler: The policy was designed to increase unemployment.
Unemployment will rise because of the policy.
The new policy will certainly reduce unemployment.
The new policy probably won't change unemployment much.
It is certain that the policy will fail.
aciklama: 'unlikely' = muhtemelen olmayacak; kesinlik bildirmez.

soru: Under no circumstances should the patient be left alone.
secenekler: The patient can sometimes be left alone.
The patient must never be left alone.
Leaving the patient alone is recommended.
The patient prefers to be alone.
The patient should be alone in some circumstances.
aciklama: 'Under no circumstances' = hiçbir koşulda = never.

soru: My grandfather used to walk five kilometres to school every day.
secenekler: My grandfather wanted to walk to school but couldn't.
My grandfather is used to walking five kilometres every day.
My grandfather still walks five kilometres to school every day.
My grandfather never walked to school.
When my grandfather was young, he walked five kilometres to school daily.
aciklama: 'used to' geçmişteki ve artık süren olmayan alışkanlığı anlatır.

soru: The streets are wet, so it must have rained during the night.
secenekler: It rained last night, but the streets dried quickly.
The streets are wet although it didn't rain.
It is almost certain that it rained during the night because the streets are wet.
It might rain tonight, so the streets will be wet.
It should have rained, but the streets are dry.
aciklama: 'must have + V3' geçmişe dair güçlü tahmin bildirir.

soru: She can't have forgotten the meeting; I reminded her this morning.
secenekler: It is impossible that she forgot the meeting, as I reminded her this morning.
She may have forgotten the meeting.
She couldn't attend the meeting because she forgot.
I forgot to remind her about the meeting.
She forgot the meeting even though I reminded her.
aciklama: 'can't have + V3' geçmişe dair güçlü olumsuz çıkarımdır: unutmuş olamaz.

soru: You should have told me you were coming.
secenekler: I didn't know whether you would come.
You must tell me when you are coming.
You told me you were coming, which was right.
You could have come without telling me.
It was a mistake not to tell me that you were coming.
aciklama: 'should have + V3' yapılmamış bir şeye yönelik eleştiridir.

soru: You needn't have bought any milk; we already had plenty.
secenekler: It was unnecessary for you to buy milk because we already had enough.
You forgot to buy milk although we needed it.
You didn't buy milk because we had plenty.
We need milk, so please buy some.
You should buy some milk; we don't have any.
aciklama: 'needn't have + V3' = yapıldı ama gereksizdi.

soru: It's high time the government did something about air pollution.
secenekler: The government took action on air pollution at the right time.
Air pollution is not a problem the government should deal with.
The government has finally solved the problem of air pollution.
The government should have acted on air pollution long ago and must do so now.
The government will act on air pollution in the future.
aciklama: 'It's high time + past' bir şeyin artık çoktan yapılması gerektiğini bildirir.

soru: You can borrow my bike as long as you bring it back by six.
secenekler: You can't borrow my bike because I need it at six.
You can borrow my bike only after six.
You can borrow my bike on condition that you return it by six.
You can keep my bike after six.
You borrowed my bike and returned it at six.
aciklama: 'as long as' = …mek şartıyla.

soru: I'll write down your number in case I forget it.
secenekler: I don't need to write down your number because I won't forget it.
I'll note your number because I might forget it.
I'll write down your number only if I forget it.
I forgot your number, so I wrote it down.
I'll write down your number after I forget it.
aciklama: 'in case' = olur da …diye, önlem olarak.

soru: I'd rather stay at home than go to the party tonight.
secenekler: I prefer staying at home to going to the party tonight.
I'll go to the party after staying at home.
I have to stay at home, so I can't go to the party.
I stayed at home instead of going to the party.
I'd like to go to the party rather than stay at home.
aciklama: 'would rather ... than' tercih bildirir; zorunluluk ya da geçmiş anlamı yoktur.

soru: The second book is not as interesting as the first.
secenekler: Neither book is interesting.
Both books are equally interesting.
The first book is more interesting than the second.
The second book is more interesting than the first.
The second book is the most interesting of all.
aciklama: 'not as ... as' = …kadar değil; birinci kitap daha ilginçtir.

soru: He no longer works for the company.
secenekler: He will soon start working for the company.
He still works for the company.
He has never worked for the company.
He used to work for the company, but he doesn't any more.
He has worked for the company for a long time.
aciklama: 'no longer' = artık değil; önceden çalışıyordu.

soru: Wearing a helmet is compulsory for all cyclists.
secenekler: Helmets are not allowed for cyclists.
Only professional cyclists wear helmets.
Cyclists don't need to wear a helmet.
Cyclists may wear a helmet if they wish.
All cyclists must wear a helmet.
aciklama: 'compulsory' = zorunlu; 'must' ile ifade edilir.

soru: The fire is thought to have started in the kitchen.
secenekler: The fire did not start in the kitchen.
People believe that the fire began in the kitchen.
The fire will probably start in the kitchen.
It has been proved that the fire started in the kitchen.
Someone thought about starting a fire in the kitchen.
aciklama: 'is thought to have + V3' geçmişe dair kesin olmayan bir kanaattir.

soru: My brother hardly ever eats vegetables.
secenekler: My brother almost never eats vegetables.
My brother eats vegetables every day.
My brother has stopped eating vegetables completely.
My brother often eats vegetables.
My brother eats vegetables only with difficulty.
aciklama: 'hardly ever' = neredeyse hiç; 'almost never' ile eş anlamlıdır.

soru: In spite of his injury, he finished the race.
secenekler: Because he was injured, he couldn't finish the race.
He got injured after finishing the race.
Although he was injured, he completed the race.
He didn't finish the race although he wasn't injured.
He finished the race and then got injured.
aciklama: 'In spite of' = …e rağmen; sakatlık yarışı bitirmesine engel olmadı.

soru: She saved money every month so as to buy a house.
secenekler: She saved money because she had bought a house.
She saved money although she didn't want a house.
She bought a house, so she couldn't save money.
She saved money every month in order to buy a house.
She bought a house every month.
aciklama: 'so as to' = 'in order to' = …mek için.

soru: It's not worth repairing this old printer.
secenekler: This old printer can't be repaired.
Repairing this old printer would be a waste of money and effort.
Repairing printers is always cheap.
This old printer is worth a lot of money.
We should repair this printer immediately.
aciklama: 'not worth + V-ing' = …meye değmez; tamirin mümkün olmadığı söylenmiyor.

soru: Whether or not you agree, the decision has already been made.
secenekler: If you don't agree, the decision will be cancelled.
The decision depends on whether you agree.
You agreed with the decision that was made.
The decision will be made after you agree.
The decision has been made, and your agreement will not change it.
aciklama: 'Whether or not' = …sen de …mesen de; karar değişmez.

soru: Only when the lights went out did we realise how late it was.
secenekler: We realised it was late, so we turned out the lights.
We didn't realise how late it was until the lights went out.
When the lights went out, we realised it was early.
The lights went out because it was late.
We realised how late it was before the lights went out.
aciklama: 'Only when ...' = ancak … olunca; 'not ... until' ile aynı anlamdadır.

soru: Had I known about the traffic, I would have taken the train.
secenekler: I didn't know about the traffic, so I didn't take the train.
I don't know whether there will be traffic.
If there is traffic, I will take the train.
I took the train because of the traffic.
I knew about the traffic, so I took the train.
aciklama: Devrik Type 3: geçmişte gerçekleşmemiş koşul; trafik bilinmedi, trene binilmedi.

soru: As a result of the strike, many flights were cancelled.
secenekler: The strike was called off because flights were cancelled.
Many flights were cancelled, which led to a strike.
Flights were cancelled before the strike started.
The strike caused the cancellation of many flights.
Despite the strike, most flights operated normally.
aciklama: Neden grevdir, sonuç iptallerdir; yön korunmalıdır.

soru: Her opinion on the matter is the same as mine.
secenekler: She has no opinion on the matter.
Her opinion is completely different from mine.
I don't know her opinion on the matter.
She changed her opinion after hearing mine.
She and I think the same about the matter.
aciklama: 'the same as' = …ile aynı; iki görüş de aynıdır.

soru: I couldn't help laughing when he fell into the pool.
secenekler: I helped him out of the pool while laughing.
He laughed when I fell into the pool.
I was unable to stop myself from laughing when he fell into the pool.
I didn't laugh when he fell into the pool.
I couldn't help him when he fell into the pool.
aciklama: 'can't help + V-ing' = kendini …mekten alamamak.

soru: It's no use complaining about the weather.
secenekler: Complaining about the weather is useful.
It is necessary to complain about the weather.
The weather has improved, so there are no complaints.
People never complain about the weather.
Complaining about the weather is pointless.
aciklama: 'It's no use + V-ing' = …mekte fayda yok.

soru: Few tourists visit the island in winter.
secenekler: No tourists visit the island at all.
Tourists prefer visiting the island in winter.
Not many tourists visit the island in winter.
The island is closed to tourists in winter.
A lot of tourists visit the island in winter.
aciklama: 'Few' = çok az (olumsuz vurgu), ama hiç değil.

soru: I set two alarms so that I wouldn't oversleep.
secenekler: I didn't set any alarms because I never oversleep.
I set two alarms to make sure I didn't oversleep.
I overslept because I set two alarms.
I overslept, so I set two alarms.
I set two alarms, but I still overslept.
aciklama: 'so that' amaç bildirir: uyuyakalmamak için.

soru: Even though he's very rich, he lives in a small flat.
secenekler: He lives in a small flat despite being very rich.
He's rich, so he bought a small flat as an investment.
He lives in a small flat because he isn't rich.
Since he's rich, he lives in a large house.
He became rich after moving to a small flat.
aciklama: 'Even though' zıtlık bildirir; 'despite' ile aynı anlamı verir.

soru: I'd rather you didn't smoke in the car.
secenekler: You didn't smoke in the car, which I liked.
You are allowed to smoke in the car.
I don't mind if you smoke in the car.
I would prefer you not to smoke in the car.
I'd like to smoke in the car.
aciklama: 'I'd rather you didn't' kibar bir rica/tercih bildirir; geçmiş anlamı yoktur.

soru: Sales are likely to fall next year.
secenekler: Sales will probably decrease next year.
Sales have never fallen.
Sales will not change next year.
Sales will definitely increase next year.
Sales fell last year.
aciklama: 'be likely to' = muhtemelen …ecek.

soru: Both my parents are teachers.
secenekler: My parents used to be students.
My parents want me to be a teacher.
Neither of my parents is a teacher.
My mother and my father are teachers.
One of my parents is a teacher.
aciklama: 'Both' = her ikisi; anne ve baba öğretmendir.

soru: So far, nobody has been able to solve the puzzle.
secenekler: The puzzle was solved a long time ago.
Up to now, the puzzle has not been solved by anyone.
Everybody solved the puzzle quickly.
Nobody will ever solve the puzzle.
Somebody is solving the puzzle now.
aciklama: 'So far' = şimdiye kadar; gelecek hakkında bir şey söylenmiyor.

soru: For the time being, the shop will stay closed on Sundays.
secenekler: The shop will open on Sundays from now on.
The shop will be closed on Sundays forever.
The shop has always been open on Sundays.
The shop was closed last Sunday.
At present, the shop will not open on Sundays, but this may change.
aciklama: 'For the time being' = şimdilik; kalıcı değildir.

soru: The species is on the verge of extinction.
secenekler: The species has recovered from extinction.
The species is not in any danger.
The species is about to become extinct.
The species is increasing in number.
The species became extinct long ago.
aciklama: 'on the verge of' = …in eşiğinde, …mek üzere.

soru: It doesn't matter to me where we eat tonight.
secenekler: I don't want to eat tonight.
We ate at a place I didn't like.
I want to eat at a particular place tonight.
I don't mind where we eat tonight.
It matters a lot where we eat tonight.
aciklama: 'It doesn't matter to me' = benim için fark etmez.

soru: I was about to leave when the phone rang.
secenekler: I didn't leave because the phone never rang.
The phone rang after I had left.
The phone rang just as I was going to leave.
I left before the phone rang.
I rang someone before leaving.
aciklama: 'was about to' = …mek üzereydim; telefon tam o sırada çaldı.

soru: Call me as soon as you arrive at the hotel.
secenekler: Call me immediately after you get to the hotel.
Call me while you are going to the hotel.
I'll call you when you arrive.
Don't call me until tomorrow.
Call me before you arrive at the hotel.
aciklama: 'as soon as' = …ır …maz; varınca hemen ara.

soru: I can't stand waiting in long queues.
secenekler: I enjoy waiting in queues.
I really hate waiting in long queues.
I can't wait in queues because I'm busy.
I have never waited in a queue.
I don't mind waiting in long queues.
aciklama: 'can't stand' = dayanamamak, nefret etmek.

soru: The new aircraft is capable of flying non-stop for twenty hours.
secenekler: The new aircraft will be tested for twenty hours.
The new aircraft must stop every twenty hours.
The new aircraft has already flown for twenty hours.
The new aircraft cannot fly for more than two hours.
The new aircraft can fly for twenty hours without stopping.
aciklama: 'be capable of' = …ebilecek kapasitede olmak; yetenek bildirir.

soru: It is essential that the samples be kept at a low temperature.
secenekler: Low temperatures damage the samples.
The samples must be stored at a low temperature.
The samples can be stored at any temperature.
It doesn't matter where the samples are kept.
The samples were accidentally kept at a low temperature.
aciklama: 'It is essential that' zorunluluk bildirir; 'must' ile ifade edilir.

soru: People tend to underestimate how much time a task will take.
secenekler: People always know exactly how long a task will take.
People usually think tasks take longer than they do.
People never plan their time.
Tasks always take less time than planned.
People generally think a task will take less time than it actually does.
aciklama: 'underestimate' = olduğundan az tahmin etmek; 'tend to' genel eğilim bildirir.

soru: None of the solutions proposed so far has proved effective.
secenekler: The solutions will be proposed later.
No solutions have been proposed so far.
All the proposed solutions have been effective.
Every solution suggested up to now has failed to work.
One of the proposed solutions has worked well.
aciklama: 'None of' = hiçbiri; önerilen çözümlerin hepsi başarısız oldu.

soru: The package was supposed to arrive yesterday.
secenekler: The package will arrive tomorrow as planned.
The package arrived yesterday as expected.
The package was expected to arrive yesterday, but it didn't.
Nobody expected the package to arrive.
The package arrived earlier than expected.
aciklama: 'was supposed to' beklenen ama gerçekleşmeyen durumu anlatır.

soru: It was such a beautiful day that we decided to have lunch outside.
secenekler: The day was so lovely that we chose to eat lunch outdoors.
The weather was bad, so we ate indoors.
We had lunch outside, so the day became beautiful.
We decided to eat outside before we saw the weather.
Although the day was beautiful, we ate inside.
aciklama: 'such ... that' neden-sonuç bildirir: gün güzel olduğu için dışarıda yendi.

soru: You won't pass the exam unless you study harder.
secenekler: If you don't study harder, you won't pass the exam.
You passed the exam because you studied hard.
You won't pass the exam even if you study harder.
If you study harder, you will fail the exam.
You will pass the exam even if you don't study.
aciklama: 'unless' = 'if not'; daha çok çalışmazsan geçemezsin.

soru: It was careless of you to leave the door unlocked.
secenekler: Someone else left the door unlocked.
You forgot to leave the door open.
You locked the door carefully.
Leaving the door unlocked was a good idea.
You were careless to leave the door unlocked.
aciklama: 'It was careless of you to' = …man dikkatsizlikti; kapıyı açık bırakan sensin.

soru: Whereas my sister loves travelling, I prefer staying at home.
secenekler: My sister and I both love travelling.
I love travelling, but my sister prefers staying at home.
My sister enjoys travelling, but I would rather stay at home.
My sister travels because I stay at home.
Neither my sister nor I like travelling.
aciklama: 'Whereas' iki kişiyi karşılaştırır; kimin neyi sevdiği korunmalıdır.

soru: The company has yet to make a profit.
secenekler: The company is making a big profit now.
The company has not made a profit so far.
The company made a profit last year.
The company has always been profitable.
The company will never make a profit.
aciklama: 'has yet to' = henüz …medi (ama bekleniyor).

soru: It is advisable to book tickets well in advance.
secenekler: Tickets are only sold on the day.
Booking tickets in advance is impossible.
You don't need to book tickets.
You are recommended to reserve tickets early.
You must not book tickets in advance.
aciklama: 'It is advisable' = tavsiye edilir.

soru: He is said to have written the novel in just three weeks.
secenekler: People say that he wrote the novel in only three weeks.
He said that he would write the novel in three weeks.
It is known for certain that he wrote the novel in three weeks.
It took him three years to write the novel.
He is writing a novel that will take three weeks.
aciklama: 'is said to have + V3' geçmişe dair söylentiyi aktarır; kesinlik bildirmez.

soru: No matter what happens, I'll support you.
secenekler: I can't support you if something happens.
What happens doesn't interest me.
I'll support you whatever happens.
I'll support you only if nothing bad happens.
Nothing will happen, so I'll support you.
aciklama: 'No matter what' = ne olursa olsun; destek koşulsuzdur.

soru: It was raining heavily; all the same, we went for a walk.
secenekler: It started raining after our walk.
We didn't go for a walk because it was raining.
We went for a walk because it had stopped raining.
We went for a walk even though it was raining heavily.
It was raining all day, so we stayed in.
aciklama: 'all the same' = yine de; zıtlık bildirir.

soru: Were it not for the internet, working from home would be impossible.
secenekler: Working from home was possible before the internet.
Working from home is only possible because of the internet.
People who work from home don't use the internet.
Without working from home, the internet would not exist.
The internet makes working from home impossible.
aciklama: 'Were it not for' = …olmasaydı; evden çalışmayı mümkün kılan internettir.

soru: Of the two proposals, the latter seems more practical.
secenekler: The first proposal seems more practical.
The two proposals were made later.
Neither proposal is practical.
Both proposals seem equally practical.
The second of the two proposals seems more practical.
aciklama: 'the latter' = ikincisi, sonra anılan.

soru: We barely had enough time to catch the train.
secenekler: We only just had enough time to catch the train.
We had plenty of time to catch the train.
We missed the train because we had no time.
We caught the train early.
We had time, but we didn't catch the train.
aciklama: 'barely' = ancak, kıl payı; treni yakaladılar.

soru: Children don't usually start reading until they are about six.
secenekler: Six-year-old children don't like reading.
Most children begin to read at around the age of six.
Children stop reading when they are six.
Children never read before the age of ten.
Most children can read before they are six.
aciklama: 'not ... until' = ancak …de; okuma altı yaş civarında başlar.

soru: Everyone will receive the same bonus regardless of their position.
secenekler: Employees in higher positions will get larger bonuses.
Only senior staff will receive a bonus.
Bonuses will depend on each employee's position.
All employees will get the same bonus, whatever their position.
Nobody will receive a bonus this year.
aciklama: 'regardless of' = …e bakılmaksızın.

soru: I could hardly believe my eyes when I saw the result.
secenekler: The result was exactly what I expected.
I didn't look at the result.
I easily believed the result.
I couldn't see the result clearly.
I found it very difficult to believe the result I saw.
aciklama: 'could hardly' = neredeyse …emedim; inanmakta zorlandım.

soru: The heavy snow prevented us from reaching the village.
secenekler: The villagers prevented us from entering because of the snow.
We reached the village before it snowed.
We couldn't get to the village because of the heavy snow.
We reached the village despite the heavy snow.
The heavy snow started after we reached the village.
aciklama: 'prevent sb from' = …i …mekten alıkoymak; köye varamadılar.

soru: It's a pity you couldn't come to the wedding.
secenekler: The wedding was cancelled.
You came to the wedding, which was nice.
I'm sorry that you weren't able to attend the wedding.
I'm glad you didn't come to the wedding.
You didn't want to come to the wedding.
aciklama: 'It's a pity' = ne yazık ki; üzüntü bildirir.

soru: The medicine didn't make him feel better; on the contrary, it made him worse.
secenekler: The medicine had no effect on him.
He stopped taking the medicine because he felt better.
He felt worse before taking the medicine.
Instead of improving his condition, the medicine made it worse.
The medicine made him feel much better.
aciklama: 'on the contrary' = tam tersine; ilaç durumunu kötüleştirdi.

soru: The new bridge is twice as long as the old one.
secenekler: The old bridge is twice as long as the new one.
The old bridge is half as long as the new one.
The two bridges are the same length.
The new bridge was built twice.
The new bridge is slightly longer than the old one.
aciklama: Yeni köprü eskinin iki katı uzunluktaysa eski köprü yeninin yarısı kadardır.

soru: I'd sooner walk than wait an hour for the bus.
secenekler: I prefer walking to waiting an hour for the bus.
I walked for an hour to the bus stop.
The bus comes every hour, so I walk.
I don't mind waiting for the bus.
I'd prefer to wait for the bus rather than walk.
aciklama: 'would sooner ... than' = 'would rather ... than'; tercih yürümektir.

soru: The reason why he left was that he had found a better job.
secenekler: He didn't leave because the job was better.
He left although he hadn't found a better job.
He found a better job after he left.
He left in order to look for a better job.
He left because he had found a better job.
aciklama: Ayrılma nedeni daha iyi bir iş bulmuş olmasıdır; iş ayrılmadan önce bulunmuştu.

soru: It's likely that the meeting will be postponed.
secenekler: The meeting will be cancelled completely.
Nobody knows when the meeting was held.
The meeting will probably be put off.
The meeting will certainly take place as planned.
The meeting was postponed yesterday.
aciklama: 'likely' olasılık bildirir; 'postpone' = 'put off'.

soru: The team succeeded in finding a cure for the disease.
secenekler: The team managed to find a cure for the disease.
The team found the disease, not the cure.
The team failed to find a cure.
The team is still looking for a cure.
The team was successful before the disease appeared.
aciklama: 'succeed in + V-ing' = 'manage to' = başarmak.

soru: As far as I know, the train service will resume next month.
secenekler: Trains have been running normally all year.
Nobody knows when the trains will start running.
The trains stopped running last month.
According to my information, trains will start running again next month.
I'm certain that trains will never run again.
aciklama: 'As far as I know' = bildiğim kadarıyla; 'resume' = yeniden başlamak.

soru: It makes no difference whether you pay by cash or card.
secenekler: Paying by cash is cheaper than paying by card.
You must pay by card.
You can't pay by cash or card.
Paying by card makes a big difference.
Paying by cash or card is equally acceptable.
aciklama: 'It makes no difference' = fark etmez; iki yöntem de kabul edilir.

soru: Taking photographs inside the museum is forbidden.
secenekler: The museum sells photographs.
You are not allowed to take photos inside the museum.
You must take photos inside the museum.
You can take photos inside the museum.
Only professional photographers can work in the museum.
aciklama: 'forbidden' = yasak; 'not allowed' ile eş anlamlıdır.

soru: Seldom have I met such a generous person.
secenekler: I often meet generous people like this.
I have rarely met anyone as generous as this person.
I met this person only once.
This person is not very generous.
I have never met a generous person.
aciklama: Devrik 'Seldom' = nadiren; bu kadar cömert birine nadiren rastladım.

soru: The village was all but destroyed by the flood.
secenekler: Only a small part of the village was damaged.
Everything except the village was destroyed by the flood.
The village was completely rebuilt after the flood.
The flood did not damage the village at all.
The flood almost completely destroyed the village.
aciklama: 'all but + V3' = neredeyse tamamen.

soru: In addition to French, she speaks German and Italian.
secenekler: She speaks only French.
She speaks German and Italian but not French.
She is learning French in addition to German.
She speaks French, German and Italian.
She speaks French better than German and Italian.
aciklama: 'In addition to' = …e ek olarak; üç dil de konuşuluyor.

soru: He is used to getting up early.
secenekler: Getting up early is not difficult for him because he does it regularly.
He used to get up early, but now he doesn't.
He has never got up early.
He will start getting up early.
He doesn't like getting up early.
aciklama: 'be used to + V-ing' = alışkın olmak; 'used to' ile karıştırılmamalıdır.

soru: I would have liked to visit the castle, but there wasn't time.
secenekler: I didn't want to visit the castle.
There was time, but the castle was closed.
I wanted to visit the castle, but I didn't have enough time.
I visited the castle because I had time.
I will visit the castle next time.
aciklama: 'would have liked to' gerçekleşmemiş bir isteği anlatır.

soru: It is still unclear what caused the explosion.
secenekler: The explosion caused a lot of confusion.
There was no explosion.
Experts know exactly why the explosion happened.
The cause of the explosion is not yet known.
The cause of the explosion was clearly identified.
aciklama: 'still unclear' = hâlâ belirsiz; neden bilinmiyor.

soru: The last bus has gone, so we might as well walk.
secenekler: We walked because we missed the first bus.
Since the last bus has left, walking is the best option available.
We might take the bus or walk.
We should wait for the next bus.
The bus is faster than walking.
aciklama: 'might as well' = başka seçenek olmadığından …sek iyi olur.

soru: The train is due to arrive at 10:30.
secenekler: The train will leave at 10:30.
The train arrived at 10:30.
The train is scheduled to arrive at 10:30.
The train is late because of the weather.
The train always arrives at 10:30.
aciklama: 'be due to + V' = …mesi planlanmış olmak.

soru: I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.
secenekler: I apologise for making you wait.
I'm sorry you couldn't wait.
I'm sorry that I have to wait for you.
You've kept me waiting for a long time.
I'm sorry you'll have to wait.
aciklama: 'to have kept you waiting' = seni beklettiğim için; bekleyen karşı taraftır.

soru: Only after the storm had passed were the roads reopened.
secenekler: The roads were reopened before the storm passed.
The storm passed after the roads had been reopened.
The storm closed the roads permanently.
The roads remained closed after the storm.
The roads were not reopened until the storm had passed.
aciklama: 'Only after ...' = ancak …den sonra; yollar fırtına geçince açıldı.

soru: The project may well take longer than expected.
secenekler: It is quite likely that the project will take more time than planned.
The project cannot take longer than planned.
The project was expected to take a long time.
The project will definitely finish early.
The project took longer than expected.
aciklama: 'may well' = büyük ihtimalle; güçlü olasılık bildirir.

soru: Mrs Arslan is in charge of the marketing department.
secenekler: Mrs Arslan works as an assistant in marketing.
Mrs Arslan is being charged by the marketing department.
Mrs Arslan has left the marketing department.
Mrs Arslan pays for marketing.
Mrs Arslan is responsible for managing the marketing department.
aciklama: 'in charge of' = …den sorumlu, …in başında.

soru: The course focuses on practical skills rather than theory.
secenekler: The course has no practical component.
The course concentrates more on practical skills than on theory.
The course gives equal weight to theory and practice.
The course is mainly theoretical.
The course teaches theory before practice.
aciklama: 'rather than' = …den ziyade; ağırlık uygulamadadır.

soru: We've run out of printer paper.
secenekler: We are running to buy printer paper.
We have bought new printer paper.
There is no printer paper left.
The printer isn't working.
We have plenty of printer paper.
aciklama: 'run out of' = tükenmek, bitmek.

soru: Neither of the candidates has enough experience.
secenekler: Neither candidate applied for the job.
One of the candidates has enough experience.
The candidates don't want experience.
Both candidates lack sufficient experience.
Both candidates have plenty of experience.
aciklama: 'Neither of' = ikisinin hiçbiri; iki adayın da deneyimi yetersiz.
